title: The Hourglass
summary: Ha-Jun masters the temporal mechanics of the Hourglass, reversing localized space-time to save an entire Section 9 battlegroup from a catastrophic antimatter ambush.

panels.shot: the dimensional slipstream between tartarus and earth
panels.action: A roaring vortex of purple nebulas and black lightning as the combined legion races through the hyperspace conduit.
panels.prose_en: A roaring vortex of purple nebulas and black lightning as the combined legion races through the hyperspace conduit.
panels.prose_hi: Hyperspace naali ke madhyam se sanyukt sena ki daud ke roop mein baingani neeharikaon aur kali bijli ka garjanshil bhanvar.

panels.shot: distant telemetry on captain baek tactical wrist comm
panels.action: Baek's comm unit crackles with panicked distress calls: 'All hunter units falling back! Seoul Defense Line Bravo has collapsed!'

dialogue.speaker: radio_dispatch
dialogue.text: MAYDAY! Three colossal entities breached the Han River sector! Perimeter overrun!

panels.prose_en: Baek's comm unit crackles with panicked distress calls: 'All hunter units falling back! Seoul Defense Line Bravo has collapsed!'.
panels.prose_hi: Bak ki com unit ghabrai hui sankatpurna call se chillati hai: 'sabhi shikari ikaiyan peeche hat rahi han! seoul raksha pankti bravo dhvast ho gai hai!'

panels.shot: ha-jun accelerating his flight speed with the hour-glass wings
panels.action: Wings of woven golden sand and purple plasma sprout from Ha-Jun's back, accelerating his velocity to Mach 10.
panels.prose_en: Wings of woven golden sand and purple plasma sprout from Ha-Jun's back, accelerating his velocity to Mach 10.
panels.prose_hi: Buni hui sunhari ret aur baingani plasma ke pankh Ha-Jun ki peeth se nikalte han, jisse uska veg mac 10 tak badh jata hai.

panels.shot: the dimensional exit tearing open over the han river in seoul
panels.action: The sky over Seoul tears open; Ha-Jun, Tae-Jun, Kuro, and the vanguard burst through into the mortal world.
panels.prose_en: The sky over Seoul tears open; Ha-Jun, Tae-Jun, Kuro, and the vanguard burst through into the mortal world.
panels.prose_hi: Siyol ke upar ka aakash khula hua hai; Ha-Jun, Tae-Jun, Kuro, aur mohra nashwar duniya mein ghus gaye.

panels.shot: seoul in apocalyptic devastation: han river burning with green void fire
panels.action: The iconic Mapo and Banpo bridges are snapped in half; the Han River boils with radioactive green void flame.
panels.prose_en: The iconic Mapo and Banpo bridges are snapped in half; the Han River boils with radioactive green void flame.
panels.prose_hi: Pratishthit mapo aur banpo pul aadhe mein toot gaye han; haan nadi radiodharmi hari shunya jwala se ubalti hai.

panels.shot: floating above yeouido: the three primordial void thrones
panels.action: Three titanic 300-foot bone thrones hover over the financial district, casting colossal shadows across the skyscrapers.
panels.prose_en: Three titanic 300-foot bone thrones hover over the financial district, casting colossal shadows across the skyscrapers.
panels.prose_hi: Teen titanic 300 foot ke asthi sinhasan vittiya jile ke upar mandrate han, jo gaganchumbi imaaraton par vishal chhaya dalte han.

panels.shot: on the southern bank: a besieged section 9 hunter regiment cornered
panels.action: Two hundred human hunters and a thousand iron demons are backed against a shattered subway terminal by void beasts.
panels.prose_en: Two hundred human hunters and a thousand iron demons are backed against a shattered subway terminal by void beasts.
panels.prose_hi: Do sau manav shikariyon aur ek hajar lohe ke rakshason ko ek toote hue metro terminal ke khilaf shunya janvaron ka samarthan prapt hai.

panels.shot: a colossal 50-foot antimatter mortar shell arcing toward the trapped hunters
panels.action: From the primary throne, a colossal fifty-foot black antimatter artillery shell screams down toward the trapped soldiers.

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain
dialogue.text: BRACE FOR IMPACT!! WE CAN'T EVACUATE IN TIME!!

panels.prose_en: From the primary throne, a colossal fifty-foot black antimatter artillery shell screams down toward the trapped soldiers.
panels.prose_hi: Prathmik sinhasan se, ek vishal pachas foot ka kala antimatter topkhane ka gola fanse hue sainikon ki or chillata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun diving from the stratosphere at mach 15
panels.action: A streak of platinum-black lightning cuts through the clouds straight toward the falling mortar shell.
panels.prose_en: A streak of platinum-black lightning cuts through the clouds straight toward the falling mortar shell.
panels.prose_hi: Platinam-kali bijli ki ek lakeer baadalon se hokar sidhe girte mortar shell ki or katati hai.

panels.shot: the antimatter mortar detonating in a blinding 500-meter black fireball
panels.action: The shell impacts the ground, expanding into a cataclysmic dome of pitch-black antimatter that begins disintegrating everything.
panels.prose_en: The shell impacts the ground, expanding into a cataclysmic dome of pitch-black antimatter that begins disintegrating everything.
panels.prose_hi: Khol jameen par prabhav dalta hai, pich-kale antimatter ke ek pralayankari gumbad mein vistarit hota hai jo sab kuch vighatit karna shuru kar deta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun landing directly in the center of the expanding fireball
panels.action: Ha-Jun hits the ground at the ground zero epicenter, planting his boots firmly into the disintegrating asphalt.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun hits the ground at the ground zero epicenter, planting his boots firmly into the disintegrating asphalt.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ground zero bhukamp ke kendra par zameen se takrata hai, aur apne jute ko majbuti se vighatit damar mein gaad deta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun raising his left palm invoking the hourglass of eternal abyss
panels.action: Ha-Jun's left palm blazes with golden chronal runes: 'HOURGLASS: TEMPORAL REVERSION!!'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's left palm blazes with golden chronal runes: 'HOURGLASS: TEMPORAL REVERSION!!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki bayin hatheli sunhare cronal runs se chamakti hai: 'aavarglas: temporal riverson!!'.

panels.shot: the expanding black fireball freezing mid-expansion
panels.action: The 500-meter dome of black destruction halts instantly, frozen in time like a glass ornament.
panels.prose_en: The 500-meter dome of black destruction halts instantly, frozen in time like a glass ornament.
panels.prose_hi: Kale vinash ka 500 meter ka gumbad turant ruk jata hai, kaanch ke aabhushan ki tarah samay ke saath jam jata hai.

panels.shot: the black fireball sucking backward in reverse motion
panels.action: The fireball implodes backward into itself; smoke, shattered concrete, and shockwaves flow back into the falling shell.
panels.prose_en: The fireball implodes backward into itself; smoke, shattered concrete, and shockwaves flow back into the falling shell.
panels.prose_hi: Aag ka gola apne aap mein peeche ki or dhans jata hai; dhuan, toota hua kankret, aur shockwaves girte hue khol mein wapas pravahit hoti han.

panels.shot: the mortar shell flying backwards 5,000 feet into the clouds
panels.action: The intact shell rockets backwards into the sky, returning straight to the throne that launched it.
panels.prose_en: The intact shell rockets backwards into the sky, returning straight to the throne that launched it.
panels.prose_hi: Akshunn shell rocket aakash mein peeche ki or jata hai, sidhe us sinhasan par lautata hai jisne ise launch kiya tha.

panels.shot: the antimatter shell detonating against the void throne's defensive shields
panels.action: The reversed shell smashes directly into the Void Throne's barrier, detonating against the enemy's own face.
panels.prose_en: The reversed shell smashes directly into the Void Throne's barrier, detonating against the enemy's own face.
panels.prose_hi: Ulta hua gola sidhe shunya sinhasan ki badha se takrata hai, jisse dushman ke chehre par visfot ho jata hai.

panels.shot: the two hundred trapped hunters opening eyes seeing themselves completely uninjured
panels.action: The soldiers lower their arms in disbelief; not a single scratch, burn, or wound exists on their bodies.

dialogue.speaker: hunter_private
dialogue.text: We're... We're alive?! The explosion vanished?!

panels.prose_en: The soldiers lower their arms in disbelief; not a single scratch, burn, or wound exists on their bodies.
panels.prose_hi: Sainikon ne avishvas se apne hathiyar neeche kar diye; unke shareer par ek bhi kharonch, jalan ya ghav nahin hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun standing before them in his platinum-streaked hair and eclipse halos
panels.action: Ha-Jun stands between the soldiers and the enemy army, his coat snapping in the wind, dual halos spinning lazily.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stands between the soldiers and the enemy army, his coat snapping in the wind, dual halos spinning lazily.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun sainikon aur dushman sena ke beech khada hai, uska coat hawa mein ud raha hai, dohra prabhamandal aalsya se ghum raha hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun landing beside ha-jun drawing twin guardian blades
panels.action: Tae-Jun impacts the pavement beside him, twin bronze swords igniting with celestial fire: 'Back off, monsters.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Nobody touches these people while we draw breath.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun impacts the pavement beside him, twin bronze swords igniting with celestial fire: 'Back off, monsters.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun apne bagal ke footpath par prabhav dalta hai, judwan kansya talwaren akashiya aag se jal rahi han: 'pichhe hato, rakshson.'

panels.shot: hunters and demons erupting into ecstatic morale-restored cheers
panels.action: The battered soldiers raise their weapons in tears: 'THE DEMON SOVEREIGN HAS RETURNED!! AND KANG TAE-JUN IS ALIVE!!'

dialogue.speaker: allied_soldiers
dialogue.text: FOR HA-JUN! FOR TAE-JUN! RETAKE THE CITY!!

panels.prose_en: The battered soldiers raise their weapons in tears: 'THE DEMON SOVEREIGN HAS RETURNED!! AND KANG TAE-JUN IS ALIVE!!'.
panels.prose_hi: Past sainik rote hue apne hathiyar uthate han: 'rakshs samprabhu wapas aa gaya hai!!' aur kang Tae-Jun jeevit hai!!'

panels.shot: on the center throne: the first void sovereign 'zeron' rising
panels.action: Rising from the center throne: 'Zeron, the Sovereign of Decay'—a 15-foot titan in black armor with four scythes for wings.

dialogue.speaker: zeron
dialogue.text: Mortal vermin... You reversed my mortar with the ancient Hourglass?!

panels.prose_en: Rising from the center throne: 'Zeron, the Sovereign of Decay'—a 15-foot titan in black armor with four scythes for wings.
panels.prose_hi: Kendriy sinhasan se uthta hua: 'zeron, the Sovereign off deke' - kale kavach mein pankhon ke liye char skith ke saath 15 foot ka titan.

panels.shot: zeron eyes burning with greedy cosmic hunger
panels.action: Zeron's face splits open in a horrific smile: 'Ten relics gathered in one fragile human shell... How convenient for my feast!'

dialogue.speaker: zeron
dialogue.text: When I devour your spine, the throne of creation belongs to the Void!

panels.prose_en: Zeron's face splits open in a horrific smile: 'Ten relics gathered in one fragile human shell... How convenient for my feast!'.
panels.prose_hi: Zeron ka chehra ek bhayanak muskan mein khul jata hai: 'ek najuk manav khol mein das avashesh ekatra hue... meri dawat ke liye kitna suvidhajnak!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping forward onto the burning han river water
panels.action: Ha-Jun steps calmly onto the surface of the boiling river; the water freezes to solid purple ice under his boots.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun steps calmly onto the surface of the boiling river; the water freezes to solid purple ice under his boots.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ubalti nadi ki satah par shanti se kadam rakhta hai; uske jooton ke neeche pani jam kar thos baingani barf ban jata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun pointing the sanguine fang straight at zeron
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks up at the 300-foot throne: 'You crawled out of your sewer to touch my home. You won't leave Earth alive.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tumne mere shehar ko chhua. Aaj tumhara aakhri din hai, Zeron.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun looks up at the 300-foot throne: 'You crawled out of your sewer to touch my home. You won't leave Earth alive.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun 300 foot oonche sinhasan ki or dekhta hai: 'tum mere ghar ko chhune ke liye apne sivar se bahar nikle. aap prithvi ko jeevit nahin chhodenge.'

panels.shot: ten thousand void beasts swarming across the ice toward ha-jun
panels.action: Ten thousand shrieking void abominations, hydras, and cyber-demons surge across the frozen river toward Ha-Jun.
panels.prose_en: Ten thousand shrieking void abominations, hydras, and cyber-demons surge across the frozen river toward Ha-Jun.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki or jami hui nadi ke paar das hajar chikhate hue shunya ghrinit padarth, hydra aur cyber-rakshs badhte han.

panels.shot: ha-jun raising his right hand manifesting the shadow legion
panels.action: Ha-Jun commands the Eclipse Devourer: 'Rise, Shadows of the Sovereign!!'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun commands the Eclipse Devourer: 'Rise, Shadows of the Sovereign!!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun grahan bhakshak ko aadesh deta hai: 'utho, samprabhu ki chhaya!!'

panels.shot: ten thousand shadow soldiers rising from the ice with glowing violet eyes
panels.action: From every shadow on the frozen river, ten thousand armored specters in midnight plate rise with blades drawn.
panels.prose_en: From every shadow on the frozen river, ten thousand armored specters in midnight plate rise with blades drawn.
panels.prose_hi: Jami hui nadi par pratyek chhaya se, aadhi raat ki plate mein das hajar bakhtarband darshak blade khinche hue uthte han.

panels.shot: the two colossal armies colliding in the center of the frozen han river
panels.action: The Shadow Legion and the Void Horde collide with the sound of a shattering tectonic plate, blood and oil spraying.
panels.prose_en: The Shadow Legion and the Void Horde collide with the sound of a shattering tectonic plate, blood and oil spraying.
panels.prose_hi: Shaido leason aur void hoard ek tutne wali tectonic plate, khoon aur tel ke chhidkav ki awaz ke saath takrate han.

panels.shot: ha-jun and tae-jun launching side-by-side toward the three thrones
panels.action: Ha-Jun and Tae-Jun vault into the sky, twin streaks of starlight rocketing straight toward the three void monarchs.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun and Tae-Jun vault into the sky, twin streaks of starlight rocketing straight toward the three void monarchs.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun aur Tae-Jun aakash ki or badhte han, taron ki roshni ki judwan dhariyan sidhe teen shunya samraton ki or badhti han.

panels.shot: the three void sovereigns drawing their weapons cliffhanger
panels.action: All three Void Sovereigns draw their colossal weapons as the sky turns to fire—the ultimate war has begun!
panels.prose_en: All three Void Sovereigns draw their colossal weapons as the sky turns to fire—the ultimate war has begun!.
panels.prose_hi: Jaise hi aakash aag mein badal jata hai, teenon shunya samprabhu apne vishal hathiyar nikaal lete hain - antim yudh shuru ho gaya hai!
